description: This file contains a script to set up a PBAC-enabled organization with custom roles, users, and teams in a Prisma-managed database. It includes functions for creating roles with specific permissions, users with assigned roles, and a team within the organization, along with seed logic executed if run directly.

methods.name: createPBACOrganization
methods.description: Main function to create an organization with roles, users, and team setup for PBAC.

methods.name: createCustomRoles
methods.description: Creates custom roles with specific permissions for the organization.

methods.name: createUsersWithRoles
methods.description: Creates users with assigned roles and profiles within the organization.

methods.name: createTeamWithCustomRoles
methods.description: Creates a team and assigns users with specific roles.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Helper to create a user with schedules and hashed password.

methods.name: createMembership
methods.description: Helper to create a membership linking a user to a team with a role.

methods.name: createProfile
methods.description: Helper to create a user profile linked to an organization.

methods.name: getPasswordForUser
methods.description: Returns predefined passwords based on user email.

methods.name: getPermissionsForRole
methods.description: Returns role permissions based on user email.
